import re
p = "ledgerly/invoice.py"
s = open(p).read()
old = '''def average_unit_price(invoice: Invoice):
    """Quantity-weighted average unit price of the invoice's lines."""
    raise NotImplementedError
'''
new = '''def average_unit_price(invoice: Invoice) -> Decimal:
    """Quantity-weighted average unit price of the invoice's lines."""
    total_quantity = sum(line.quantity for line in invoice.lines)
    if total_quantity == 0:
        return ZERO
    weighted_total = sum(
        (to_money(line.unit_price) * line.quantity for line in invoice.lines), ZERO
    )
    return round_money(weighted_total / total_quantity)
'''
assert old in s
open(p, "w").write(s.replace(old, new))
EOF
cat ledgerly/invoice.py"}
